claims.text: The behavior of node R26-M0-N0-I:J18-U11 is more concerning due to the repeated occurrence of DCR read timeout errors over a prolonged period of approximately 40 minutes, with the first error occurring at 06:41:29 and the last at 07:20:51.

In contrast, node R02-M0-N4-C:J04-U11 experienced a series of data cache search parity errors on a different day, October 17, with the errors occurring over a shorter period of approximately 33 minutes, from 05:02:27 to 05:35:12.
Notably, the errors on R02-M0-N4-C:J04-U11 were accompanied by attempts to correct the issue, whereas the errors on R26-M0-N0-I:J18-U11 did not indicate any corrective actions being taken.

The fact that the DCR read timeout errors on R26-M0-N0-I:J18-U11 recur without any intervening corrective action suggests that the root cause of these errors is a persistent issue that is not being addressed.
